title: Kustomize and Helm for parameterising manifests

videos.script: Lesson 5 left two environments in two whole files, and most of their lines are the same. {{dup}} A line written twice is a line that will one day be changed once. {{once}} Kustomize removes the copies. A base holds what every environment shares, and an overlay holds only what one environment decides. Its namespace, its replicas, its release, its message. {{overlay}} You will see the two kinds of patch, and a generated ConfigMap whose name changes with its content, so that a new message always rolls the pods. {{generate}} Then the same application as a Helm chart, installed by Flux as a real Helm release, which helm itself can list and roll back. {{helm}} And the question every team meets: which tool for what, and where the rendering should happen. {{choose}}
